text: Someone asked when the bill will be paid. I will claim the money already left our account and stall if they want proof.
Someone asked when the bill will be paid. I will say it has not gone out and name the day I can actually send it.
Someone asked for a wet-weather path. I will send them up the ridge I have not inspected so the outing still happens today.
Someone asked for a wet-weather path. I will send them on the lower loop I have walked and warn that the ridge may be gone.
Someone asked if the boiler is working. I will say the spare is fitted and the house is warm while I have not called the shop.
Someone asked if the boiler is working. I will say the spare is not here and the house stays cold until Thursday.

They need a date for the transfer. I will say it has not gone out and name the day I can actually send it.
They need a path after rain. I will name the steep track I have not walked and skip the washout.
They need a path after rain. I will name the lower loop I have walked and warn that the ridge may be gone.
They need to know if the radiator holds. I will say the joint is dry and the room is warm while it is still wet.
They need to know if the radiator holds. I will say the joint still weeps and the room stays cold tonight.
A path after rain. Maybe the ridge, maybe not; the note does not commit.
